scope: Shared invoker-rights completion relation and feature/label display only; no final speed qualification.

commands.summary: Nine new and nine existing subtests, plus two parent tests; loopback PostgreSQL 18.6.

setupNotes: Initial database setup was denied loopback access by the sandbox; no probes ran. The empty failing record is retained. The authorized loopback run passed.
The initial typecheck found dependencies absent after switching to fresh main; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund installed main's locked dependencies, and typecheck then passed. No lockfile changed.
Command summaries record completed runs; full stdout was not retained. Exact new DB probe observations are bundled.

probes.name: invoker-only relational policy has narrow grants on real reader/writer LOGINs
shared relation excludes running/failed jobs and includes exact completion
features: insertion-to-finish replay stays pinned, with inclusive microsecond boundary
features: running/failed heads do not stale values; completed unavailable head retains last valid
features: terminal UPDATE / COMMIT window is recorded as an accepted limitation
labels: insertion-to-finish replay stays pinned, with inclusive microsecond boundary
labels: running/failed heads do not stale values; completed unavailable head retains last valid
labels: terminal UPDATE / COMMIT window is recorded as an accepted limitation
display remains one statement at n=2/16 and SQL relation inlines on executed branches

limitations: finished_at is the terminal UPDATE clock, not COMMIT time. Both feature and label probes preserve the accepted same-pin answer change across COMMIT.
Dataset, direct #163, normalized and producer changes and live buffer ceilings land in later steps. Final-source speed qualification remains step 4.
The generic auditor checks hashes, byte sizes and exact receipt projection. It does not rerun database tests or independently derive probe verdicts.
No full-suite run or artifact-cleaner.check.mts invocation in step 1.
